# Actual initialized empty installation, whole-bundle backup and relocated root.
# Companion publication requires a private script-owned working directory.
chmod 0700 .
mkdir root
chmod 0700 root
skygo state artifacts init --data-dir state --artifact-dir root --ack-writers-stopped
skygo --json state artifacts backup --data-dir state --artifact-dir root --output bundle --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^\{"complete":true\}\n$'
! stderr .
exists bundle/jobs.db
exists bundle/manifest.json
exists bundle/objects
cp bundle/jobs.db original.db
skygo --json state artifacts restore --input bundle --data-dir restored --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^\{"complete":true\}\n$'
! stderr .
exists restored/jobs.db
exists restored/artifacts/.skygo-artifact-root
cmp original.db bundle/jobs.db
# Backup the actual relocated installation, not a fabricated filesystem mirror.
skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir restored --artifact-dir restored/artifacts --output second-bundle --ack-writers-stopped
stdout '^backup complete\n$'
! stderr .
# No replacement of bundle or restored installation, even with explicit ack.
! skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir state --artifact-dir root --output bundle --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
cmp original.db bundle/jobs.db
! skygo state artifacts restore --input bundle --data-dir restored --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
exists restored/artifacts/.skygo-artifact-root
mkdir empty-existing
! skygo state artifacts restore --input bundle --data-dir empty-existing --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
! exists empty-existing/jobs.db
